title: planner's in
description: What the main conversation starts the planner with: the cut tree.py start planner printed, word for word.

start.description: The run values, the JSON object on the first line of the cut tree.py start printed, each a value the guard holds the role's calls to. The rest of the cut follows it.

tree.description: The design tree's path, which the planner's every_item lane reads at the items port.

edit.description: The path of the tree edit the planner writes, in the system's temporary folder.

practice.description: The plan best practice's path, whose practices are the planner's steps.

vital_few.description: The intents whose practices the planner carries out, null for every one.
